headlines.description: — Anthony Edwards scored 39 points, including an unlikely 3-pointer that sealed the game, and the Minnesota Timberwolves held off the Boston Celtics 119-115 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Edwards caps 39-point performance with unlikely 3 as Timberwolves hold off Celtics 119-115

headlines.description: — Miles Bridges scored 10 of his 35 points in overtime and the Charlotte Hornets overcame a 17-point first half deficit to beat Toronto 118-111 on Saturday night, ending the Raptors' nine-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bridges scores 35 points as Hornets overcome 17-point deficit to beat Raptors 118-111 in OT

headlines.description: — Pascal Siakam sank a 14-foot jumper with a second left to give the Indiana Pacers a 103-101 victory over the Chicago Bulls on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Siakam's last-second jumper lifts Pacers over Bulls, 103-101

headlines.description: — Cade Cunningham scored 29 points, Duncan Robinson had 18 in his return to Miami and the Eastern Conference-leading Detroit Pistons held off the Heat 138-135 on Saturday night to snap a two-game skid.
headlines.shortLinkText: Duncan Robinson gets a win in return to Miami, as Pistons hold off Heat 138-135

headlines.description: — Giannis Antetokounmpo scored 29 points and topped the 21,000-point mark for his career on Saturday night as the Milwaukee Bucks snapped a seven-game losing streak with a 116-99 victory over the short-handed Brooklyn Nets.
headlines.shortLinkText: Antetokounmpo scores 29, surpasses 21,000 career points in Bucks' 116-99 win over Nets

events.name: New Orleans Pelicans at Golden State Warriors

headlines.description: — Jimmy Butler had 24 points, 10 assists and eight rebounds, and the Golden State Warriors beat the New Orleans Pelicans 104-96 on Saturday night playing without Stephen Curry after he bruised his left quadriceps muscle Wednesday night in a home loss...
headlines.shortLinkText: Butler leads Curry-less Warriors past Pelicans, 104-96

headlines.description: — Nikola Jokic scored 26 points, Jamal Murray added 24 and the Denver Nuggets pulled away late to beat the Phoenix Suns 130-112 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jokic scores 26 and Murray adds 24 to lead the hot-shooting Nuggets past the Suns 130-112

headlines.description: — Cooper Flagg had a season-high 35 points and Klay Thompson scored 17 of his 23 in the fourth quarter to rally the Dallas Mavericks to a 114-110 victory over the Los Angeles Clippers on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flagg scores season-high 35 and Thompson rallies Mavericks past Clippers 114-110
